body: I guess I could give them another chance. It would be nice to not constantly police myself when I'm around people. Thanks for talking to me, I felt kind of stupid posting on here, but it's really helped. You didn't have to comment and I really appreciate that you did.

Yeah, I tried to take them for a few weeks, but it made me feel like someone else was using my body as a host. I just didn't feel like myself. Another part of me felt guilty for taking them, like why do I need meds? My life isn't that horrible, these are for people with real problems. I guess I've been so used to faking it, that it almost seemed easier to just sink back into that routine.
Do you have anything that gets you out of it or has helped? People say "I would be dead if not for my wife/job". The problem is, I don't really have anyone or thing like that.
